700:t_10:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$, the one inside you, has met $$ガイオウ$$ face to face, hasn't he?」

700:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... During the $$破界事変$$, not long after the 《$$カラミティ・バース$$》.」

700:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What kind of man was he away from the battlefield?」

700:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I spoke with him while he still had amnesia, so my impression may be skewed...」

700:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Put kindly, he was single-minded... Put unkindly, he was arrogant.」

700:t_10:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So the same as $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

700:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And, $$クロウ$$... In the way they throw away everything and die for their mission, you see yourself.」

700:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z that were produced when you fought $$ヴィルダーク$$ told me so. I'll add these to the stock.」

700:t_10:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ガイオウ$$, that guy, and I all have blood on our hands. I've got no right to say anything about them...」

700:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If I'm any different from that guy, it's only that I was blessed with good people around me...」

700:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Being able to make use of that was your own strength, $$クロウ$$. ...It may be small comfort, but allow me to say it.」

700:t_10:18.en:
$$エスター$$
「What are you doing, $$クロウ$$?」

700:t_10:19.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「We're about to enter the long-range jump to chase the $$御使い$$s. Get ready too.」

700:t_10:20.en:
$$青山$$
「Could it be you were asking $$ＡＧ$$ for advice on paying off your debt?」

700:t_10:21.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That one's a real Chip-miser, too. You'll get some good advice from $$ＡＧ$$, I bet.」

700:t_10:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If you're going to ask a guy like that, ask me instead. I'm pretty confident in my penny-pinching skills.」

700:t_10:23.en:
$$デュオ$$
「With traits that alike, you can't refuse to be certified as one of the gang...」

700:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll be using the $$スフィア$$s to track $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, too. Hurry up and get ready, $$クロウ$$.」

700:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The swaying scales... Your strong will could, if it goes one step wrong, become the power to walk the road to ruin.)

700:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But you have overcome your past and live alongside comrades who share your goal, so I believe you will surely walk the right path.)

700:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Your debt will dog you forever, though...)

700:t_10:34.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「W-What do you want, $$ＡＧ$$?」

700:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please, don't be so wary. Everyone and I have reconciled, at least for the time being, haven't we?」

700:t_10:36.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「That's not it. $$セツコ$$ has been telling me for a while to be careful whenever you're within a one-meter radius.」

700:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...All I wanted was to celebrate defeating the $$次元将$$ together with $$マルグリット$$...」

700:t_10:38.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sorry...! I let a petty prejudice make me misread your consideration...」

700:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, it's all right. I'm... an existence that deserves to be condemned, after all.」

700:t_10:40.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sorry... If you can forgive me, give me a chance to make amends.」

700:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to present you with this custom-made white $$ライノダモン$$ costume, made by me...」

700:t_10:44.en:
$$エスター$$
「I knew it'd be something like that!」

700:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「E-$$エスター$$! When did you get a paper fan!?」

700:t_10:46.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$かなめ$$ taught me how to make one.」

700:t_10:47.en:
$$エスター$$
「If you try anything outrageous with $$マルグリット$$ again, I won't stay quiet...」

700:t_10:50.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「This costume... I'll stuff it and display it in my room.」

700:t_10:51.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「In place of a memorial portrait of my late brother...」

700:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... yes... Um... I'm glad you like it...」

700:t_10:53.en:
$$エスター$$
「Since $$ＡＧ$$ has lost all the venom, I'll mind the shop today!」

700:t_10:54.en:
$$エスター$$
「All right then, let's work hard again today... Business, business!」

700:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It strayed from my original plan, but seeing $$マルグリット$$'s smile makes it good enough...」

701:t_000:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Well, let's see what fate has in store for us...」

701:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't intend to lose, no matter what comes.」

701:t_000:2.en:
$$葵$$
「If anything, I'd like the $$御使い$$s to come. We're short on time, so I want to settle this quickly.」

701:t_000:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Your spirits are high, I see. They'll be arriving any moment now.」

701:t_001:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Earthlings! I will commend you for defeating $$バアル$$.」

701:t_001:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And for opening the path to this $$カオス・コスモス$$, as well.」

701:t_001:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「So $$ミケーネ$$ also planned to use our power to invade the $$御使い$$s' universe.」

701:t_001:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Just so. The same goes for them.」

701:t_002:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Have the gods of $$オリュンポス$$ and my father and the others joined hands!?」

701:t_002:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「It was all to win the True War... no, to defeat the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_002:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Once we get inside the universe where they live, all that remains is to push forward!」

701:t_002:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「But before that, we will destroy you, who have given us such trouble, and seize the four $$スフィア$$s!」

701:t_002:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Higher-dimensional life forms... an alliance of gods!」

701:t_002:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Wrong, $$ゼロ$$. These guys call themselves gods, but they're what you'd call evil gods.」

701:t_002:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A gathering of evil gods that bring nothing but misfortune and calamity to humanity is nothing other than unnecessary.」

701:t_002:8.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Don't get full of yourselves, you mere humans!」

701:t_002:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Wait...! We have the same goal of defeating the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_002:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The enemy's power is far too great. For now, I propose a ceasefire.」

701:t_002:11.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Oh... so you would bow to our power?」

701:t_002:12.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Hahahaha! So you've finally learned your place!」

701:t_002:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Bear with it for now, $$勝平$$.」

701:t_002:15.en:
$$シン$$
「We even teamed up with that $$ＡＧ$$, at least for the time being. First let's at least try talking...」

701:t_002:16.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That is what I call getting full of yourselves, humans!」

701:t_003:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So there's no room for negotiation...!」

701:t_003:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Negotiation? Talk in your sleep!」

701:t_003:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Why should we gods have to talk on equal footing with the likes of humans?」

701:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You...! Do you still not understand the truth of living in the universe!?」
